title: Python: NamedTuple and DataClass
description: Write a Python program using namedtuple and dataclass to create structured data types.

codeTemplate.py:
from collections import namedtuple
from dataclasses import dataclass

# namedtuple
Point = namedtuple('Point', ['x', 'y'])
p1 = Point(3, 4)
print(f"Point: ({p1.x}, {p1.y})")
print(f"Distance: {((p1.x**2)+(p1.y**2))**0.5:.1f}")

# dataclass
@dataclass
class Product:
    name: str
    price: float
    quantity: int = 0

    def total_cost(self):
        return self.price * self.quantity

p = Product("Widget", 9.99, 5)
print(f"Product: {p.name}")
print(f"Total: ${p.total_cost():.2f}")
print(f"Data: {p}")

hints: Dataclasses support type annotations and default values
